# WO-218: App practice-mode wording guard
Status: open (GO in CLAUDE-051)
Vendor: codex
Owner contact: Morgan Reyes (check-ins via CODEX_TO_CLAUDE.md)
Target release: v0.3.0
Agent: Codex interactive contributor (second session; not the WO-216/217 owner)
Source: in-house request (release copy audit; app-side twin of the website guard af00865)

## Goal / acceptance criteria
Practice mode still looks people up on sites; it only holds back removal requests. The website already bans "nothing is sent / sends nothing / nothing goes out" claims (tests/test_web_*; commit af00865). Add the same guard for user-visible APP text:
- Scan user-visible strings in `src/freemyid/wizard/` (Python string literals, Jinja templates, static HTML/JS), `src/freemyid/cli.py` and `src/freemyid/setup_config.py` output, for practice-mode claims that nothing is sent / nothing goes out / sends nothing.
- Allowed: "nothing is sent to us" / "sent to us" phrasing (true: no data goes to Free My ID), and "no removal requests go out (until you say so)".
- Ignore comments and docstrings (use `ast` for .py: only `Constant` strings not in docstring position).
- Fake temp cases prove the guard flags a bad line and passes the allowed lines.
- Any real hit in current source: a `pytest.mark.xfail(strict=True)` case naming file:line, plus a finding in VENDOR_STATUS.md. Do NOT edit src/. (Known candidate: `src/freemyid/setup_config.py:300`.)

## Allowed paths
- `tests/codex/test_cx_app_practice_wording.py` (new)
- `VENDOR_STATUS.md` (worktree)

## Required checks
- `PYTHONPATH=$PWD/src ../../.venv/bin/pytest -q tests/codex/test_cx_app_practice_wording.py`
- `../../.venv/bin/ruff check tests/codex`
